description: This file defines the PHP class 'tlReports' which encapsulates functionality related to generating reports and retrieving test plan data from a database in the TestLink project. It includes methods for listing reports, counting builds, and counting test cases linked to a test plan.

classes.name: tlReports
classes.description: A class that provides methods for creating reports and metrics data, querying test plans and builds within the TestLink testing framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes database connection and test plan identifiers for the tlReports class.

methods.name: get_list_reports
methods.description: Returns an array of report items with URLs, toggle controls, and links, based on context, report configuration, and format filters.

methods.name: get_count_builds
methods.description: Returns the count of builds for the current test plan, with optional filtering for active and open builds.

methods.name: get_count_testcase4testplan
methods.description: Returns the count of test cases associated with the current test plan.
